name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz Yilmaz's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for flight and aerodynamics. He earned a degree in aerospace engineering from Istanbul Technical University, then honed his skills at smaller racing outfits before landing a role at a Formula 3 team. There, he quickly rose through the ranks, contributing significantly to their aerodynamic development program. Deniz believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing wind tunnel results and track data to extract every last bit of performance. 

His demanding nature stems from a relentless pursuit of perfection. He is known to push his team hard, but also fosters a culture of continuous improvement and learning. He joined Arrow McLaren with the ambition of turning them into the most aerodynamically advanced team on the grid, bringing with him a wealth of experience and a reputation for innovation. He is particularly interested in maximizing downforce while minimizing drag, always searching for novel solutions to improve the car's aerodynamic efficiency. 

Deniz is also an advocate for sustainable technologies in motorsport. He's currently leading a project to improve the car's energy recovery system.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Deniz is of average height with a focused look and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using metric measurements exclusively, even when discussing topics with international colleagues.
